title: albizia kalkora var. coreana
intro: Albizia kalkora var. coreana, commonly known as Korean Albizia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae and is native to East Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as reducing fever and alleviating cough. The therapeutic actions of Albizia kalkora var. coreana include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
